import re
import sys

values = {}

for line in sys.stdin:
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0].strip()
    if not line:
        continue

    match = re.fullmatch(r"(\w+)\s*<-\s*(.+)", line)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, expression = match.groups()
    expression = expression.strip()

    match = re.fullmatch(r"\(\s*(\w+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+)", expression)
    if match:
        source, increment, modulus = match.groups()
        values[name] = (values[source] + int(increment)) % int(modulus)
    else:
        values[name] = int(expression)

print(
    f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; c ?= {values['c']}; "
    f"d ?= {values['d']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};"
)
